answer: Resist sybils with sortition-gated identity issuance: each epoch, applicants enter a public lottery and only a small random subset win identity slots, like stars picked from a nebula. Each application costs a non-refundable fee and a locked bond, so an attacker chasing ten thousand fakes must file a hundred thousand applications and pay for every one, crossing a tundra of fees with ferrous certainty that most will fail. Honest agents apply once and usually win within a few epochs, while mass forgery becomes a losing gamble.
